scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && node --inspect=9229 server.js" "cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev"
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.deploy:backend:dev: npm run build:backend:dev && gcloud run services replace cloud-run.dev.yaml --project projectDevId --region regionId
scripts.deploy:backend:prod: npm run build:backend:prod && gcloud run services replace cloud-run.prod.yaml --project projectProdId --region regionId
scripts.deploy:frontend:dev: npm run build:frontend && firebase deploy --only hosting --project projectDevId
scripts.deploy:frontend:prod: npm run build:frontend && firebase deploy --only hosting --project projectProdId
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run deploy:backend:dev && npm run deploy:frontend:dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run deploy:backend:prod && npm run deploy:frontend:prod
